name: finrep
description: SEC reporting and technical accounting research with citations, from your Finrep account.

interface.longDescription: Bring Finrep's SEC reporting and technical accounting research into ChatGPT. Search EDGAR filings, accounting standards, and SEC comment letters, benchmark disclosure language against peers, and draft disclosures. Every answer cites the source it came from, so reporting teams can verify it before it goes into a filing.
capabilities: Find what the SEC has pushed back on in comment letters
Benchmark disclosure language against peer filings
Draft disclosure language grounded in real filings
Open your saved Finrep drafts, documents and citations
defaultPrompt: Ask Finrep what the SEC has pushed back on in recent comment letters about non-GAAP measures.
Use Finrep to compare how U.S. Bancorp, PNC and Truist word interest-rate-risk disclosure in their latest 10-Ks.
Draft a revenue recognition footnote in Finrep for a company with subscription and usage-based revenue.

positive.prompt: Ask Finrep what the SEC has pushed back on in recent comment letters about non-GAAP measures.
positive.expected_behavior: A cited answer; each claim links to the comment letter it came from

positive.prompt: Now show me the same for segment reporting.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a turn to the same Finrep chat, cited, without restating context

positive.prompt: Show me the source behind the first citation in that answer.
positive.expected_behavior: The company, form type, fiscal year and filing link behind that citation

positive.description: Peer disclosure benchmark across named regional banks
positive.prompt: Use Finrep to compare how U.S. Bancorp, PNC and Truist word interest-rate-risk disclosure in their latest 10-Ks.
positive.expected_behavior: The actual interest-rate-risk disclosure language from each bank's latest 10-K, quoted and cited to its filing

positive.prompt: Open my Gaia Q2 FY2026 footnote disclosure brief in Finrep.
positive.expected_behavior: The artifact's title and text preview, with an Open-in-Finrep link

negative.description: Unsupported edit of an uploaded document
negative.prompt: Edit the revenue figures in my uploaded document in Finrep and save it.

review.commerce_description: Finrep does not sell anything through ChatGPT. Users sign in with an existing Finrep account.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: first public release. Research SEC filings, comment letters and accounting standards with citations; continue earlier Finrep chats; open the user's own Finrep chats, documents, artifacts and citations.
